entities.summary: John Peter Gassiot FRS [also Gassiott] was an English businessman and amateur scientist. He was particularly associated with public demonstrations of electrical phenomena and the development of the Royal Society. John Peter Gassiot was a performers & entertainers from London (1797-04-02, London–1877-08-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
